newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia not worried by ringgit's rise - Anwar.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia not worried by ringgit's rise - Anwar.

text.p: The ringgit's rise against the dollar in the last one month was no cause for worry, local newspapers quoted Malaysia's Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim as saying on Wednesday.
"The economy is strong and the ringgit seems to be strengthening against the U.S. dollar. But, it is very, very minimal," the daily New Straits Times quoted him as saying.
"I don't think it is an issue that should be highlighted or be overly concerned about," Anwar said.
He said the ringgit's position should not only be viewed against the U.S. dollar, but against a basket of currencies.
"And in the basket, the ringgit has been consistent. Therefore, there is no need for concern," he said.
